headline: Tom Welling reflects on Smallville legacy
post:
Can you believe it has been 25 years since Clark Kent first stepped onto our screens? According to Screen Rant, Tom Welling recently reflected on the iconic DC prequel during a special anniversary interview. The star discussed how the television landscape has shifted since the days of traditional 22-episode seasons, noting that the longer format allowed viewers to truly invest in the characters. Welling also shared insights from rewatching the series on his podcast with Michael Rosenbaum, explaining how getting scripts week to week meant they did not always know the full picture of the overarching storylines while filming. It is amazing to see how much love this incredible Superman origin story still receives today! Who is your favorite character from the series?

#Smallville #TomWelling #Superman
original_title: Smallville 25th Anniversary Interview: Tom Welling Reflects On The Past, Present & Future For His Superman
